knowledge.title: Customer profile, 2026

The buyer is the CTO or the head of engineering, and in larger companies the head of security. site.title: Northgate Cloud, managed Kubernetes for software companies
site.description: Managed Kubernetes, hosting and 24/7 operations for software companies that would rather build product than run clusters.
site.markdown:
# Managed Kubernetes for software companies

Northgate runs the clusters, the upgrades, the backups and the on-call so your engineers ship product. Data centers in Amsterdam, Frankfurt and Ashburn.

## Who runs on Northgate

More than 400 software companies, from a team of ten to a few hundred engineers. Most are B2B SaaS companies selling to enterprises in Europe and North America.

## Security and compliance

ISO 27001 certified data centers. Single sign-on, audit logs and a shared responsibility matrix for your own audits. Many customers use the matrix in their SOC 2 and ISO 27001 work.

## Partners

We work with monitoring, backup and security vendors. Ask about the alliances program.

steps.title: Map the matrix to our controls
steps.detail: We map your shared responsibility matrix to the SOC 2 and ISO 27001 hosting controls once. Every shared customer inherits it.

steps.title: Add a line to your renewal checklist
steps.detail: When a customer asks for a SOC 2 report or an ISO certificate, your account manager introduces us. We do the same for hosting.

steps.title: Run the first three audits together
steps.detail: We take three shared customers through the audit and note what the auditor still asked about hosting.

steps.title: Decide on a bundle
steps.detail: After the three audits we decide whether to sell it as one package or keep it as a referral.

first_step.title: A 30 minute call with your alliances lead
first_step.detail: We walk through your shared responsibility matrix next to our hosting control list and count how many controls it already answers. You leave with that count. I leave knowing whether the mapping is a week of work or a month.
first_step.ask: Send the current matrix before the call, and tell me who owns renewals on your side.
